review.why: Guides creating and improving skills: interview, draft, test prompts against a baseline, review in a viewer, iterate, then tune the description.
review.summary: Captures intent through an interview, writes the skill file, saves test prompts, runs each with and without the skill in parallel, grades assertions, aggregates a benchmark and opens a review viewer for the user's feedback before iterating. A separate loop optimizes the skill description on train and held-out queries, and packaging produces an installable file.
strengths: Baseline comparison runs in the same turn as the skill run
Explains the why instead of heavy MUSTs and keeps prompts lean
Adapts the workflow for code, chat and cowork environments
cautions: Long and tied to the vendor's tooling: subagents, its command-line tool and a file-presenting tool
Runs many scripts and background processes that are not read here
Some informal asides and repeated emphasis
